Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeCloud - procurement readiness & MAP (post-call recap)

Hi Sam - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the agreed next steps so we stay aligned on the procurement path and timeline. Attaching the updated mutual action plan (MAP) and a SOW stub for your procurement team to review.

Summary / asks from today:
- Procurement path: you mentioned preference for a Purchase Order (PO) and finance-led payment. Can you confirm PO vs card?
- Marketplace: you asked if Redwood is available in the AWS marketplace - short answer: yes, but if AcmeCloud requires a marketplace purchase we can discuss timing and whether security/legal is OK with that path.
- Timeline / milestones we discussed (please confirm):
  1) Legal review (contract redlines) - AcmeCloud legal indicated ~2 weeks after receiving SOW/contract
  2) Security review (questionnaire + evidence) - estimated 5-7 business days
  3) Finance review & PO issuance - target after legal/security sign-off
- Action items for AcmeCloud: share PO template (if you use one), confirm marketplace interest, and confirm stakeholders for legal/security/finance review.

What I need from you this week to keep momentum:
- PO vs card confirmation and PO template (if PO)
- Any additional security evidence besides the vendor questionnaire we attached previously
- Preferred target date for going live / pilot start

Attachments: AcmeCloud_MAP_v2.pdf; Redwood_SOW_stub.docx

Proposed next step: quick mutual-action-plan check-in next week (30 min) to lock dates. I can coordinate once you confirm availability.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

From: Sam Torres <s.torres@acmecloud.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud - procurement readiness & MAP (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa - great summary. A few notes from procurement/finance/security side: 

- Procurement path: AcmeCloud prefers a PO for anything over our procurement threshold; so PO is likely. I will share our PO template (procurement@acmecloud.com) - sending separately.
- Marketplace: we would prefer marketplace if possible because it simplifies billing, but our security team tends to prefer a direct contract for any solution with data access. If Redwood is fine with both, we will make the decision based on legal/security guidance.
- Timeline (internal estimates):
  * Security review (info-sec questionnaire + evidence) - target completion by 2026-03-25 (we have a dedicated reviewer available next week)
  * Legal review (contract redlines) - aiming to complete by 2026-04-01 (couple of negotiable items we anticipate)
  * Finance / PO issuance - target by 2026-04-08 once legal & security sign-off are done

I can confirm stakeholders: Alice Chen (Legal), Diego Martinez (Security), Priya N. (Finance).

Ask: can you provide a short one-page summary of the pilot scope and expected costs we can circulate to finance? Also please include the SOW and a sample invoice schedule.

I'll plan a MAP check-in on 2026-03-25 unless you suggest otherwise.

Best,
Sam Torres
Senior Product Manager - Integrations | AcmeCloud
s.torres@acmecloud.com
